mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in demand (GDPC1) predicts higher consumer spending and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 rises but 20d returns are negative, or IC <0.05 over 3mo rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 3.5% signals monetary easing, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decline below 3.5% but 20d returns are negative, or IC <0.03 over 2yr window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both demand (GDPC1) and the federal funds rate signals conflicting trends, but strong consumer demand outweighs tightening policies, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If both GDPC1 and FEDFUNDS rise but returns are negative, or IC <0.05 over 20d window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained drop in unemployment rates below 3.5% signals labor market strength and reduced inflationary pressures, fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE drops below 3.5% in late-cycle but returns are negative, or IC <0.03 over 3yr window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in supply-side indicators (INDPRO) reflects robust production and inventory accumulation, boosting corporate profits and investor confidence, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises but 5d returns are negative, or IC <0.05 over 5d window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in labor employment above 160,000 thousand persons signals a strong job market, enhancing consumer spending and corporate growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS exceeds 160,000 but returns are negative, or IC <0.03 over 20d window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous surge in both demand (GDPC1) and supply-side activity (INDPRO) indicates a balanced economic expansion, reducing uncertainty and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise but returns are negative, or IC <0.03 over 60d window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a decline in demand-side indicators (RSAFS) below 750,000 signals normalization and reduced recessionary pressures, fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines below 750,000 in post-shock but returns are negative, or IC <0.05 over 5d window.
